mapper.select: select from reading_plan_item i join reading_plan p on p.id = i.plan_id join member m on m.id = p.member_id join book b on b.id = i.book_id where i.plan_id = #{planId} and i.book_id = #{bookId}

select from reading_plan_item i join reading_plan p on p.id = i.plan_id join member m on m.id = p.member_id join book b on b.id = i.book_id where i.plan_id = #{planId} order by i.sequence_no for update
mapper.insert: insert into reading_plan_item(plan_id, book_id, sequence_no, priority, status, progress_percent, source, planned_start_date, planned_finish_date, note, version) values(#{planId}, #{bookId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{progressPercent}, #{source}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedFinishDate}, #{note}, 0)
mapper.update: update reading_plan_item set sequence_no = sequence_no + #{offset} where id = #{id}

update reading_plan_item set sequence_no = #{sequenceNo}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_finish_date = #{plannedFinishDate}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, note = #{note}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.delete: delete from reading_plan_item where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select count(*) from reading_plan_item where plan_id = #{planId} and status = #{status}
